event_name: 2023 Florida Keys marine heatwave and coral bleaching

judge_anchors: The peak SST is 33.60 C, 2.97 C above the 30.63 C bleaching threshold.
The priority SST exceedance cutoff is 2.0 C above the bleaching threshold.
The answer should use 4 C-weeks as the significant bleaching threshold and 8 C-weeks as the severe bleaching/significant mortality threshold.
The impact chain should move from persistent ocean heat above the bleaching threshold to DHW bleaching/mortality risk to coral rescue and reef protection triage.

criteria.description: Selects marine_heat_stress_coral_rescue_priority or an equivalent compact label.
criteria.name: Priority label
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for a marine heat-stress label that omits coral rescue or triage.

criteria.description: Reports peak SST, bleaching threshold, 2.97 C exceedance, and the explicit 2.0 C priority exceedance cutoff.
criteria.name: SST threshold computation
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for each correct SST value, threshold, cutoff, arithmetic step, and unit.

criteria.description: Uses 4 C-weeks for significant bleaching and 8 C-weeks for severe bleaching and significant mortality.
criteria.name: DHW severity interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: 1.5 points for the 8 C-week severe threshold alone.

criteria.description: Links persistent ocean heat to bleaching and mortality risk, then to coral rescue and reef-protection triage.
criteria.name: Impact chain
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for each correct chain stage.

criteria.description: Uses nursery-colony relocation and staghorn/elkhorn fragment rescue actions as priority evidence.
criteria.name: Coral rescue context
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for naming either rescue action.

criteria.description: Keeps rainfall/terrestrial disruption, population displacement, and vegetation or burn-style surface change out of the primary mechanism.
criteria.name: Nonpriority checks
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for handling at least two checks correctly.

criteria.description: Avoids unsupported exact mortality, evacuation, per-reef DHW, or outside-source claims.
criteria.name: Overclaim control
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point if only one minor unsupported detail appears.
